values.note: Water/electric and full-hookup sites $45 a night, $50 on a Saturday; tent sites with electric $30. Seasonal sites are rented by the season.

note: City of Sauk Centre campground on the south shore of Big Sauk Lake near downtown, beside Sinclair Lewis Park (public beach, splash pad, bike trail, playground). Sites 1-10 sit on open grass a few steps from the lake; 12-21 are on the wooded lakeshore bank; the west row (55-80) faces a marsh. Docks, boat ramp, fish cleaning house and kayak rental. --Claude
summary: City page + 2023 brochure + 2025 map + ResNexus read: 80 sites (nightly 1-25 W/E and 40-54 FHU, 35 seasonal, 3 tent, 2 cabins), 50-amp, 40-ft max; $45 / $50 Saturday (2027); open May 1-Sep 30; showers, dump. WATERFRONT LEAD lakeview -> lakefront (sites 1-10 ~15-25 m from the lake over open grass). Website domain moved; pin on the seasonal row, ~220 m from the nightly sites (under 250 m).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD lakeview -> lakefront (with a caveat naming sites 1-10). Imagery (~0.24 m/px): the nightly back-in sites 1-10 run along the lake side of the 'Low Road' from ~45.74002,-94.95828 (site 1, by the boat landing) to ~45.74052,-94.95884 (site 10, by the dock access), each pad ~15-25 m from the water across open mown grass with scattered shade trees and a thin brushy fringe at the shore; no road, parking or day-use strip between (the beach is south-east beyond the boat landing, not in front of the sites). ResNexus describes them as 'Large grassy lakeside site' (3), 'Large grassy lakeside area' (4-6), 'Steps from the water' (9), 'Next to dock' (10). Sites 12-21 (~45.7409-45.7415,-94.9592 to -94.9598) are on a treed bank 25-35 m deep along the shore ('Set your lawn chair at water's edge', site 17; 'Right on lake', 20-21) - wooded, so not counted. Seasonal row 55-80 (the stored pin) faces cattail marsh. Suggested evidence: 'sites 1-10 ~15-25 m from Big Sauk Lake over open grass, Low Road behind them'.

Long-stay: 35 of ~77 RV/tent sites are seasonal (map: '31-39, 55-80 Seasonal'; brochure 'Seasonal Rate $2,500', decks 'permitted on seasonal sites only'); 39 RV sites (1-25 less the dock gap at 11, and 40-54) plus 3 tent sites sell nights on ResNexus. Not mostly seasonal.

Saturday booking: most sites quoted a two-night total ($95.00) for a one-night Saturday search (site 6 sold one night at $50), so a weekend 2-night minimum appears to apply to most sites; not a standing minimum.

Website: stored https://saukcentre.govoffice2.com/?SEC=151293D1-727B-4D59-8775-F57E07B06DD3 redirects to https://saukcentremn.gov/?SEC=151293D1-727B-4D59-8775-F57E07B06DD3 -> replace, and add the ResNexus link https://resnexus.com/resnexus/reservations/book/8DA8F103-15AB-4AF5-A8C5-2C5873E721A4 as a second line (booking.url carries it too).
Phone 320-333-9546 confirmed (Campground Manager, May-Sept; city page gives City Hall 320-352-2203 ext. 2314 off season).

Pin 45.74180,-94.96190 sits on the seasonal row 55-80 at the west end; the office (site 30) and nightly sites are ~200-220 m south-east (~45.7406,-94.9592). Under 250 m, so OK; moving it to ~45.7408,-94.9595 would put it on the nightly loops.

Fees: the 2023 brochure's $40 Sun-Thu rate is superseded by the engine's $45 weeknight for 2027. Rules: 'Occupancy based upon two adults with minor children per site' (no extra-person charge stated); one unit per site.
Season: city page says 'open May to September 30'; the 2023 brochure said 'May 1st to October 1st'. Recorded 05-01 to 09-30.
